summary: Mirror native fused solve and warmstart for small Metal scenes, sharing per-constraint arithmetic with wide color launches.
regressions: Fresh Rust Coulomb and twist fixtures cover bias modes, multiple independent batches, shared static negative-zero velocities, partial workgroups and ranges exceeding 64 lanes.
Fused and separate Metal schedules compare every word exactly, including an inserted empty color.
Large contact capacities and non-Metal targets retain ordered wide dispatches.
differences: A 512-contact average allocation heuristic selects Metal fusion; native Rust can use its latest pair-count estimate. This is a performance heuristic, not a correctness bound.

One workgroup per independent batch, ascending colors and explicit device-memory barriers preserve dependencies. Cached fused and tail variants remain substituted by separate launches. No physics formula, tolerance or Rust reference change.
Full matrix and Ascend device qualification remain deferred; baseline is not reconciled.
